# Community Rule Column 7 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** complete

---

**7:1** Whoever knowingly lies about property shall be excluded from the pure food of the Many for one year and shall have

**7:2** his food ration reduced by one quarter. Whoever answers his neighbor with obstinacy or speaks with impatience of

**7:3** spirit, thereby undermining the authority of his associate who is registered before him — his own hand has brought this upon him; he shall be punished

**7:4** for one year. Whoever utters anything by the Name that is honored above all — whether he curses while stricken by

**7:5** distress or for any other reason, while reading the book or while praying — he shall be separated and shall never return

**7:6** to the council of the community. If he spoke against one of the priests who are registered

**7:7** in the book while in anger, he shall be punished for one year and set apart by himself from the pure food of

**7:8** the Many. But if he spoke inadvertently, he shall be punished for six months. Whoever deliberately

**7:9** lies shall be punished for six months. Whoever insults his neighbor without

**7:10** just cause shall be punished for one year and excluded. Whoever speaks to his neighbor with deceit

**7:11** or knowingly wrongs him — his punishment is six months. If he was negligent

**7:12** toward his neighbor — his punishment is three months. Whoever borrows from

**7:13** his neighbor's property without asking — his punishment is three months. Every man who bears a grudge

**7:14** against his neighbor without just cause shall be punished for six months. Likewise, whoever

**7:15** takes personal vengeance in any matter — his punishment is six months. Whoever speaks foolishly — three months. Whoever interrupts his neighbor

**7:16** while he is still speaking — ten days. Whoever lies down and sleeps during the session of

**7:17** the Many — thirty days. Likewise, whoever leaves the session of the Many without

**7:18** permission and without reason, up to three times in one session, shall be punished ten days. But if

**7:19** they are standing and he departs — thirty days. Whoever appears naked before

**7:20** his neighbor without being compelled — six months. The man who spits in the midst of the session of

**7:21** the Many — thirty days. Whoever extends his left hand to gesticulate

**7:22** with it — ten days. The man who slanders his neighbor

**7:23** shall be excluded from the pure food of the Many for one year and punished. But the man who slanders

**7:24** the Many shall be expelled from among them and shall not return. The man who murmurs against

**7:25** the authority of the community shall be expelled and shall not return.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 7 preserves the Penal Code of the Qumran community. "The Many" (ha-rabbim) is retained as a sectarian technical term following LOGOS and EMET. "Pure food" is preserved over PNEUMA's "sacred meal" since tohorat specifically denotes ritual purity status. Penalties range from ten days to permanent expulsion. SOPHIA follows LOGOS closely here, with EMET's construct chains smoothed and PNEUMA's paraphrases restrained where sectarian precision is needed.*
